def check_isoforms(acc):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json")
    data = r.json()
    print(f"=== {acc} ===")
    print("Canonical mass:", data['sequence']['molWeight'], "Da")
    # check alternative products
    for c in data.get('comments', []):
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            for iso in c.get('isoforms', []):
                print(iso.get('name'), iso.get('isoformIds'), iso.get('isoformSequenceStatus'))
